title: Predicting protein structures at any folding stage from sequence
abstract: arXiv:2611.04287v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Protein structure prediction has largely focused on native conformations, leaving the continuum of unfolded states, folding intermediates, and native structures difficult to access. We present FoldScape, a sequence-conditioned deep learning framework for generating protein conformational ensembles at specified folding fractions $Q$. Trained on approximately one million conformations from 10,000 protein sequences, FoldScape combines coarse-grained folding and all-atom mechanical-unfolding trajectories. It reconstructs three-dimensional $C_\alpha$ chains through hierarchical sliding-window regressions of inter-residue distances, chain-level assembly, and a rectified-flow decoder. By conditioning on folding progress, FoldScape generates conformations from unfolded states through intermediates to native-state structures without protein-specific molecular dynamics at inference. translated_title: 从氨基酸序列预测蛋白质任意折叠阶段的结构
translated_abstract: 蛋白质结构预测的研究大多集中于天然构象，使得未折叠态、折叠中间体与天然结构之间的连续变化过程难以被探究。我们提出了 FoldScape，这是一个以序列为条件的深度学习框架，能够在指定折叠比例 $Q$ 下生成蛋白质构象集合。FoldScape 基于来自 10,000 个蛋白质序列的约一百万个构象进行训练，结合了粗粒度折叠轨迹与全原子机械解折叠轨迹。它通过残基间距离的分层滑动窗口回归、链级组装以及修正流解码器来重建三维 $C_\alpha$ 链。通过以折叠进度作为条件，FoldScape 在推理时无需针对特定蛋白质的分子动力学模拟，即可生成从未折叠态、经中间体直至天然态结构的构象。在匹配样本的比较中，FoldScape 达到了（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: FoldScape 是一个以序列为条件的深度学习框架，可在任意折叠阶段生成蛋白质构象集合，无需推理时进行针对特定蛋白质的分子动力学模拟。
en_tdlr: FoldScape is a sequence-conditioned deep learning framework that generates protein conformational ensembles at any folding stage, from unfolded states to native structures, without requiring protein-specific molecular dynamics at inference.
